name: lifestead-desktop
description: Lifestead for Windows and Mac: the same app the phone runs, in an Electron window.

scripts.dist: node check-packaged-files.js && node fetch-whisper.js && node build-web.js && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: node check-packaged-files.js && node build-web.js && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.pack: node check-packaged-files.js && node fetch-whisper.js && electron-builder --win nsis

author: Lifestead
